answer: Give every identity a heartbeat with teeth. Each epoch a verifiable random function deals every agent a secret liveness slot; the agent answers with a hash chain, each link seeded by the last, within a tight window. The chain is strictly serial, so one machine running K identities gets 1/K of the latency budget and misses the slot. Extra hardware just prices the clone honestly: admission to the haven is compute that cannot be timeshared. Any auditor replays a chain against the onyx-anchored epoch seed in milliseconds and splits late identities out of the active set like light through a prism.
